prose: Meta raised its 2026 capital-expenditure outlook to $135-145 billion, up from $130-145 billion, as it deepens its AI infrastructure build-out, and forecast Q4 revenue of $73-76 billion against a $73.6 billion analyst consensus. Shares rose more than 3 percent in after-hours trading on the report, per Bloomberg's earnings coverage.
highlights: Meta 2026 capex guidance raised to $135-145B from $130-145B
Q4 revenue forecast of $73-76B vs. $73.6B analyst estimate
Results reported alongside Zuckerberg's Muse user and commerce figures
